reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5 — traced the defect in Cloudflare request logs, then verified the guards in the built output
method: Share-URL defect: Cloudflare zone analytics attributed all 334 weekly /photography/photo/null requests to Facebook's scraper (167x 404, 167x 504). Traced to two builders interpolating a possibly-null image_key, one of which feeds the Facebook share button. Replaced with photoShareUrl() returning null, guarded both call sites so share controls hide rather than emitting a dead link, and added a pre-query 404 in /photo/[id] for null/undefined/NaN. No reader-facing copy changed — the only visible difference is that share controls no longer appear for an item that cannot be addressed by URL.
